definitions.name: Parameters
definitions.text:
structure Parameters where
  h : ℝ
  t1 : ℝ
  t0 : ℝ
  rA : ℝ
  rB : ℝ
  rC : ℝ
  rAB : ℝ
  rR : ℝ
  g : ℝ

definitions.name: Admissible
definitions.text:
def Admissible (p : Parameters) : Prop :=
  0 < p.h ∧ p.h < p.t1 ∧ p.t1 < p.t0 ∧
  0 < p.g ∧ p.g < 1 ∧
  0 < p.rA ∧ 0 < p.rB ∧ 0 < p.rC ∧ 0 < p.rAB ∧ 0 < p.rR

definitions.name: Pair
definitions.text:
inductive Pair where
  | AC | AB | BC | AA | CC | BB
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

definitions.name: pairTransform
definitions.text:
def pairTransform (p : Parameters) (pair : Pair) (z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let u := p.t1 - p.h
  let v := p.t0 - p.t1
  let E : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => Real.exp (-z * t)
  let S : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun r l => Real.exp (-r * l)
  let H : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun r l =>
    r / (r + z) * (1 - Real.exp (-(r + z) * l))
  let root := p.rR / (p.rR + z)
  let s := S p.rB p.h
  let b := S p.rB u
  let a := S p.rAB v
  let c1 := S p.rC (u + v)
  let a0 := S p.rA p.t1
  let c0 := S p.rC p.t0
  match pair with
  | .AC => E p.t0 * root
  | .AB =>
      (1 - p.g) * E p.t1 * H p.rAB v +
        (p.g + (1 - p.g) * a) * E p.t0 * root
  | .BC =>
      p.g * E p.h * H p.rC (u + v) +
        (1 - p.g + p.g * c1) * E p.t0 * root
  | .AA =>
      H p.rA p.t1 + a0 * E p.t1 * H p.rAB v +
        a0 * a * E p.t0 * root
  | .CC => H p.rC p.t0 + c0 * E p.t0 * root
  | .BB =>
      H p.rB p.h + s *
        ((1 - p.g) ^ 2 * E p.h * H p.rB u +
          p.g ^ 2 * E p.h * H p.rC (u + v) +
          (1 - p.g) ^ 2 * b * E p.t1 * H p.rAB v +
          ((1 - p.g) ^ 2 * b * a + p.g ^ 2 * c1 +
            2 * p.g * (1 - p.g)) * E p.t0 * root)

definitions.name: jcPairExponent
definitions.text: def jcPairExponent : ℝ := 8 / 3

definitions.name: nineRawFeatures
definitions.text:
def nineRawFeatures (p : Parameters) : Fin 9 → ℝ :=
  ![pairTransform p .AC jcPairExponent,
    pairTransform p .AC (2 * jcPairExponent),
    pairTransform p .CC jcPairExponent,
    pairTransform p .BC jcPairExponent,
    pairTransform p .BC (2 * jcPairExponent),
    pairTransform p .AB jcPairExponent,
    pairTransform p .AB (2 * jcPairExponent),
    pairTransform p .AA jcPairExponent,
    pairTransform p .BB jcPairExponent]

definitions.name: rootMoment
definitions.text:
def rootMoment (t r z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp (-z * t) * (r / (r + z))

definitions.name: rootRatio
definitions.text:
def rootRatio (r c : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (r + c) ^ 2 / (r * (r + 2 * c))

definitions.name: pulseScore
definitions.text: def pulseScore (x B₁ B₂ : ℝ) : ℝ := (x ^ 2 - B₂) / (x - B₁)

definitions.name: pulseWeight
definitions.text:
def pulseWeight (T R r c t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp (-r * t) * (Real.exp (-c * t) - rootMoment T R c)

definitions.name: pulseScoreAt
definitions.text:
def pulseScoreAt (T R c t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  pulseScore (Real.exp (-c * t)) (rootMoment T R c) (rootMoment T R (2 * c))

definitions.name: pulseKernelTwo
definitions.text:
def pulseKernelTwo (T R r c t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp (-r * t) * (Real.exp (-(2 * c) * t) - rootMoment T R (2 * c))

definitions.name: pulseKernel
definitions.text:
def pulseKernel (T R r z t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp (-r * t) * (Real.exp (-z * t) - rootMoment T R z)

definitions.name: pulseShiftedMoment
definitions.text:
def pulseShiftedMoment (T R r z h : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp (-z * h) * (r / (r + z)) *
      (1 - Real.exp (-(r + z) * (T - h))) +
    Real.exp (-r * (T - h)) * rootMoment T R z

definitions.name: fixedContinuationMoment
definitions.text:
def fixedContinuationMoment (L z K r : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  r / (r + z) * (1 - Real.exp (-(r + z) * L)) + Real.exp (-r * L) * K

definitions.name: fixedContinuationDerivative
bcExcess
definitions.text:
def bcExcess (p : Parameters) (z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  pairTransform p .BC z - rootMoment p.t0 p.rR z

definitions.name: bcExcessRatio
definitions.text:
def bcExcessRatio (p : Parameters) (c : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  bcExcess p (2 * c) / bcExcess p c

definitions.name: aaContinuation
definitions.text:
def aaContinuation (p : Parameters) (z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp (-z * p.t1) *
    fixedContinuationMoment (p.t0 - p.t1) z
      (Real.exp (-z * (p.t0 - p.t1)) * (p.rR / (p.rR + z))) p.rAB

definitions.name: abCrossTerm
definitions.text:
def abCrossTerm (D : ℝ → ℝ) (c s t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp (-c * t) * (Real.exp (-c * t) - Real.exp (-c * s)) * D t

definitions.name: abSurvival
definitions.text: def abSurvival (a r t : ℝ) : ℝ := Real.exp (-r * max (t - a) 0)

definitions.name: abSurvivalDiff
definitions.text:
def abSurvivalDiff (a₁ r₁ a₂ r₂ t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  abSurvival a₁ r₁ t - abSurvival a₂ r₂ t

definitions.name: abCrossing
definitions.text:
def abCrossing (a₁ r₁ a₂ r₂ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (r₂ * a₂ - r₁ * a₁) / (r₂ - r₁)

definitions.name: bbRootTail
definitions.text:
def bbRootTail (L R z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp (-z * L) * (R / (R + z))

definitions.name: bbABRelativeTail
definitions.text:
def bbABRelativeTail (p : Parameters) (z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp (-z * (p.t1 - p.h)) *
    fixedContinuationMoment (p.t0 - p.t1) z
      (bbRootTail (p.t0 - p.t1) p.rR z) p.rAB

definitions.name: bbStayContinuation
bbRouteContinuation
definitions.text:
def bbRouteContinuation (p : Parameters) (z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp (-z * p.h) *
    fixedContinuationMoment (p.t0 - p.h) z
      (bbRootTail (p.t0 - p.h) p.rR z) p.rC

definitions.name: bbTail
bbForwardAt
definitions.text:
def bbForwardAt (p : Parameters) (z r : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  fixedContinuationMoment p.h z (bbTail p z r) r

headers.name: rootRatio_gt_one
headers.header:
theorem rootRatio_gt_one (r c : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hc : 0 < c) :
    (1 : ℝ) < (r + c) ^ 2 / (r * (r + 2 * c))

headers.name: ac_transform_eq_rootMoment
headers.header:
theorem ac_transform_eq_rootMoment (p : Parameters) (z : ℝ) :
    pairTransform p .AC z = rootMoment p.t0 p.rR z

headers.name: rootRatio_eq_one_add
headers.header:
theorem rootRatio_eq_one_add (r c : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hc : 0 < c) :
    rootRatio r c = 1 + c ^ 2 / (r * (r + 2 * c))

headers.name: rootRatio_strictAnti
headers.header:
theorem rootRatio_strictAnti (a b c : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c) (hab : a < b) :
    rootRatio b c < rootRatio a c

headers.name: rootRatio_injective
headers.header:
theorem rootRatio_injective (a b c : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c)
    (heq : rootRatio a c = rootRatio b c) : a = b

headers.name: rootMoments_ratio
headers.header:
theorem rootMoments_ratio (t r c : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hc : 0 < c) :
    rootMoment t r (2 * c) / (rootMoment t r c) ^ 2 = rootRatio r c

headers.name: rootRate_eq_of_moments_eq
headers.header:
theorem rootRate_eq_of_moments_eq (t t' r r' c : ℝ)
    (hr : 0 < r) (hr' : 0 < r') (hc : 0 < c)
    (h1 : rootMoment t r c = rootMoment t' r' c)
    (h2 : rootMoment t r (2 * c) = rootMoment t' r' (2 * c)) :
    r = r'

headers.name: rootRate_eq_of_nineRawFeatures_eq
headers.header:
theorem rootRate_eq_of_nineRawFeatures_eq (p q : Parameters)
    (hp : Admissible p) (hq : Admissible q)
    (hF : nineRawFeatures p = nineRawFeatures q) : p.rR = q.rR

headers.name: rootTime_eq_of_rootMoment_eq
headers.header:
theorem rootTime_eq_of_rootMoment_eq (t t' r c : ℝ)
    (hr : 0 < r) (hc : 0 < c)
    (h : rootMoment t r c = rootMoment t' r c) : t = t'

headers.name: rootTime_eq_of_nineRawFeatures_eq
headers.header:
theorem rootTime_eq_of_nineRawFeatures_eq (p q : Parameters)
    (hp : Admissible p) (hq : Admissible q)
    (hF : nineRawFeatures p = nineRawFeatures q) : p.t0 = q.t0

headers.name: pulse_score_difference
headers.header:
theorem pulse_score_difference (a b B₁ B₂ : ℝ)
    (ha : a ≠ B₁) (hb : b ≠ B₁) :
    pulseScore b B₁ B₂ - pulseScore a B₁ B₂ =
      (b - a) * (1 + (B₂ - B₁ ^ 2) / ((b - B₁) * (a - B₁)))

headers.name: pulse_score_strict_in_x
headers.header:
theorem pulse_score_strict_in_x (a b B₁ B₂ : ℝ)
    (ha : B₁ < a) (hab : a < b) (hvar : B₁ ^ 2 < B₂) :
    pulseScore a B₁ B₂ < pulseScore b B₁ B₂

headers.name: root_moment_variance_pos
headers.header:
theorem root_moment_variance_pos (T R c : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (hc : 0 < c) :
    rootMoment T R c ^ 2 < rootMoment T R (2 * c)

headers.name: root_moment_lt_exp_at
headers.header:
theorem root_moment_lt_exp_at (T R c t : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (hc : 0 < c)
    (ht : t ≤ T) : rootMoment T R c < Real.exp (-c * t)

headers.name: pulse_score_strict_decrease_time
headers.header:
theorem pulse_score_strict_decrease_time (T R c t₁ t₂ : ℝ)
    (hR : 0 < R) (hc : 0 < c) (h12 : t₁ < t₂) (h2 : t₂ ≤ T) :
    pulseScore (Real.exp (-c * t₂)) (rootMoment T R c) (rootMoment T R (2 * c)) <
      pulseScore (Real.exp (-c * t₁)) (rootMoment T R c) (rootMoment T R (2 * c))

headers.name: weighted_split_ratio_strict
headers.header:
theorem weighted_split_ratio_strict (wl wr il ir middle : ℝ)
    (hwl : 0 < wl) (hwr : 0 < wr)
    (hleft : middle * wl < il) (hright : ir < middle * wr) :
    ir / wr < (il + ir) / (wl + wr)

headers.name: weighted_tail_ratio_strict
headers.header:
theorem weighted_tail_ratio_strict (w q : ℝ → ℝ) (a b c : ℝ)
    (hab : a < b) (hbc : b < c)
    (hw : ContinuousOn w (Set.Icc a c))
    (hq : ContinuousOn q (Set.Icc a c))
    (hwpos : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a c, 0 < w t)
    (hanti : StrictAntiOn q (Set.Icc a c)) :
    (∫ t in b..c, w t * q t) / (∫ t in b..c, w t) <
      (∫ t in a..c, w t * q t) / (∫ t in a..c, w t)

headers.name: pulse_weight_positive
headers.header:
theorem pulse_weight_positive (T R r c t : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (hc : 0 < c)
    (ht : t ≤ T) : 0 < pulseWeight T R r c t

headers.name: pulse_weight_continuous
headers.header: theorem pulse_weight_continuous (T R r c : ℝ) : Continuous (pulseWeight T R r c)

headers.name: pulse_score_continuousOn
headers.header:
theorem pulse_score_continuousOn (T R c : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (hc : 0 < c) :
    ContinuousOn (pulseScoreAt T R c) (Set.Iic T)

headers.name: pulse_weight_mul_score
headers.header:
theorem pulse_weight_mul_score (T R r c t : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (hc : 0 < c)
    (ht : t ≤ T) : pulseWeight T R r c t * pulseScoreAt T R c t =
      pulseKernelTwo T R r c t

headers.name: pulse_kernel_ratio_strict
headers.header:
theorem pulse_kernel_ratio_strict (T R r c a b : ℝ)
    (hR : 0 < R) (hc : 0 < c) (hab : a < b) (hbT : b < T) :
    (∫ t in b..T, pulseKernelTwo T R r c t) /
        (∫ t in b..T, pulseWeight T R r c t) <
      (∫ t in a..T, pulseKernelTwo T R r c t) /
        (∫ t in a..T, pulseWeight T R r c t)

headers.name: bc_transform_split
headers.header:
theorem bc_transform_split (p : Parameters) (z : ℝ) :
    pairTransform p .BC z = (1 - p.g) * rootMoment p.t0 p.rR z +
      p.g * pulseShiftedMoment p.t0 p.rR p.rC z p.h

headers.name: integral_exp_linear
headers.header:
theorem integral_exp_linear (k a b : ℝ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    (∫ t in a..b, Real.exp (k * t)) =
      (Real.exp (k * b) - Real.exp (k * a)) / k

headers.name: pulse_kernel_integral_closed
headers.header:
theorem pulse_kernel_integral_closed (T R r z h : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hz : 0 < z) :
    (∫ t in h..T, pulseKernel T R r z t) =
      (Real.exp (-(r + z) * T) - Real.exp (-(r + z) * h)) / (-(r + z)) -
        rootMoment T R z * (Real.exp (-r * T) - Real.exp (-r * h)) / (-r)

headers.name: pulse_excess_integral
headers.header:
theorem pulse_excess_integral (T R r z h : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hz : 0 < z) :
    pulseShiftedMoment T R r z h - rootMoment T R z =
      r * Real.exp (r * h) * (∫ t in h..T, pulseKernel T R r z t)

headers.name: exponential_tail_bracket_pos
headers.header:
theorem exponential_tail_bracket_pos (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) :
    0 < 1 - (1 + x) * Real.exp (-x)

headers.name: fixed_continuation_derivative_pos
headers.header:
theorem fixed_continuation_derivative_pos (L z K r : ℝ)
    (hL : 0 < L) (hz : 0 < z) (hr : 0 < r) (hK : K ≤ Real.exp (-z * L)) :
    0 < fixedContinuationDerivative L z K r

headers.name: fixed_continuation_hasDerivAt
headers.header:
theorem fixed_continuation_hasDerivAt (L z K r : ℝ)
    (hz : 0 < z) (hr : 0 < r) :
    HasDerivAt (fixedContinuationMoment L z K) (fixedContinuationDerivative L z K r) r

headers.name: fixed_continuation_strictMonoOn
headers.header:
theorem fixed_continuation_strictMonoOn (L z K : ℝ)
    (hL : 0 < L) (hz : 0 < z) (hK : K ≤ Real.exp (-z * L)) :
    StrictMonoOn (fixedContinuationMoment L z K) (Set.Ioi 0)

headers.name: cc_transform_eq_fixed
headers.header:
theorem cc_transform_eq_fixed (p : Parameters) (z : ℝ) :
    pairTransform p .CC z =
      fixedContinuationMoment p.t0 z
        (Real.exp (-z * p.t0) * (p.rR / (p.rR + z))) p.rC

headers.name: cc_tail_le_start
headers.header:
theorem cc_tail_le_start (p : Parameters) (z : ℝ)
    (hp : Admissible p) (hz : 0 < z) :
    Real.exp (-z * p.t0) * (p.rR / (p.rR + z)) ≤ Real.exp (-z * p.t0)

headers.name: c_rate_eq_of_cc_eq
headers.header:
theorem c_rate_eq_of_cc_eq (p q : Parameters) (z : ℝ)
    (hp : Admissible p) (hq : Admissible q) (hz : 0 < z)
    (ht : p.t0 = q.t0) (hR : p.rR = q.rR)
    (heq : pairTransform p .CC z = pairTransform q .CC z) : p.rC = q.rC

headers.name: c_rate_eq_of_nineRawFeatures_eq
headers.header:
theorem c_rate_eq_of_nineRawFeatures_eq (p q : Parameters)
    (hp : Admissible p) (hq : Admissible q)
    (hF : nineRawFeatures p = nineRawFeatures q) : p.rC = q.rC

headers.name: bc_excess_eq_integral
headers.header:
theorem bc_excess_eq_integral (p : Parameters) (z : ℝ)
    (hr : 0 < p.rC) (hz : 0 < z) :
    bcExcess p z = p.g * (p.rC * Real.exp (p.rC * p.h) *
      (∫ t in p.h..p.t0, pulseKernel p.t0 p.rR p.rC z t))

headers.name: pulse_weight_integral_pos
headers.header:
theorem pulse_weight_integral_pos (T R r c h : ℝ)
    (hR : 0 < R) (hc : 0 < c) (hhT : h < T) :
    0 < ∫ t in h..T, pulseWeight T R r c t

headers.name: bc_excess_ratio_eq_kernel_ratio
headers.header:
theorem bc_excess_ratio_eq_kernel_ratio (p : Parameters) (c : ℝ)
    (hp : Admissible p) (hc : 0 < c) :
    bcExcessRatio p c =
      (∫ t in p.h..p.t0, pulseKernelTwo p.t0 p.rR p.rC c t) /
        (∫ t in p.h..p.t0, pulseWeight p.t0 p.rR p.rC c t)

headers.name: bc_excess_ratio_eq_of_bc_eq
headers.header:
theorem bc_excess_ratio_eq_of_bc_eq (p q : Parameters) (c : ℝ)
    (ht : p.t0 = q.t0) (hR : p.rR = q.rR)
    (h1 : pairTransform p .BC c = pairTransform q .BC c)
    (h2 : pairTransform p .BC (2 * c) = pairTransform q .BC (2 * c)) :
    bcExcessRatio p c = bcExcessRatio q c

headers.name: pulse_time_eq_of_bc_eq
headers.header:
theorem pulse_time_eq_of_bc_eq (p q : Parameters) (c : ℝ)
    (hp : Admissible p) (hq : Admissible q) (hc : 0 < c)
    (ht : p.t0 = q.t0) (hR : p.rR = q.rR) (hC : p.rC = q.rC)
    (h1 : pairTransform p .BC c = pairTransform q .BC c)
    (h2 : pairTransform p .BC (2 * c) = pairTransform q .BC (2 * c)) :
    p.h = q.h

headers.name: pulse_probability_eq_of_bc_eq
headers.header:
theorem pulse_probability_eq_of_bc_eq (p q : Parameters) (c : ℝ)
    (hp : Admissible p) (hc : 0 < c)
    (ht : p.t0 = q.t0) (hR : p.rR = q.rR) (hC : p.rC = q.rC)
    (hh : p.h = q.h)
    (h1 : pairTransform p .BC c = pairTransform q .BC c) : p.g = q.g

headers.name: pulse_parameters_eq_of_nineRawFeatures_eq
headers.header:
theorem pulse_parameters_eq_of_nineRawFeatures_eq (p q : Parameters)
    (hp : Admissible p) (hq : Admissible q)
    (hF : nineRawFeatures p = nineRawFeatures q) : p.h = q.h ∧ p.g = q.g

headers.name: fixed_continuation_le_one
headers.header:
theorem fixed_continuation_le_one (L z K r : ℝ)
    (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hz : 0 < z) (hr : 0 < r) (hK : K ≤ Real.exp (-z * L)) :
    fixedContinuationMoment L z K r ≤ 1

headers.name: aa_transform_eq_fixed
headers.header:
theorem aa_transform_eq_fixed (p : Parameters) (z : ℝ) :
    pairTransform p .AA z = fixedContinuationMoment p.t1 z (aaContinuation p z) p.rA

headers.name: aa_continuation_le_start
headers.header:
theorem aa_continuation_le_start (p : Parameters) (z : ℝ)
    (hp : Admissible p) (hz : 0 < z) : aaContinuation p z ≤ Real.exp (-z * p.t1)

headers.name: a_rate_eq_of_aa_eq
headers.header:
theorem a_rate_eq_of_aa_eq (p q : Parameters) (z : ℝ)
    (hp : Admissible p) (hq : Admissible q) (hz : 0 < z)
    (ht1 : p.t1 = q.t1) (ht0 : p.t0 = q.t0)
    (hAB : p.rAB = q.rAB) (hR : p.rR = q.rR)
    (heq : pairTransform p .AA z = pairTransform q .AA z) : p.rA = q.rA

headers.name: a_rate_eq_of_nineRawFeatures_eq
headers.header:
theorem a_rate_eq_of_nineRawFeatures_eq (p q : Parameters)
    (hp : Admissible p) (hq : Admissible q)
    (hF : nineRawFeatures p = nineRawFeatures q)
    (ht1 : p.t1 = q.t1) (hAB : p.rAB = q.rAB) : p.rA = q.rA

headers.name: ab_transform_split
headers.header:
theorem ab_transform_split (p : Parameters) (z : ℝ) :
    pairTransform p .AB z = p.g * rootMoment p.t0 p.rR z +
      (1 - p.g) * pulseShiftedMoment p.t0 p.rR p.rAB z p.t1

headers.name: ab_shifted_eq_of_ab_eq
headers.header:
theorem ab_shifted_eq_of_ab_eq (p q : Parameters) (z : ℝ)
    (hp : Admissible p) (ht : p.t0 = q.t0) (hR : p.rR = q.rR)
    (hg : p.g = q.g)
    (heq : pairTransform p .AB z = pairTransform q .AB z) :
    pulseShiftedMoment p.t0 p.rR p.rAB z p.t1 =
      pulseShiftedMoment q.t0 q.rR q.rAB z q.t1

headers.name: ab_shifted_eq_fixed
headers.header:
theorem ab_shifted_eq_fixed (T R r z a : ℝ) :
    pulseShiftedMoment T R r z a = Real.exp (-z * a) *
      fixedContinuationMoment (T - a) z
        (Real.exp (-z * (T - a)) * (R / (R + z))) r

headers.name: ab_rate_eq_at_fixed_onset
headers.header:
theorem ab_rate_eq_at_fixed_onset (T R r s z a : ℝ)
    (hR : 0 < R) (hr : 0 < r) (hs : 0 < s) (hz : 0 < z) (ha : a < T)
    (heq : pulseShiftedMoment T R r z a = pulseShiftedMoment T R s z a) : r = s

headers.name: ab_shifted_moments_eq_of_nineRawFeatures_eq
headers.header:
theorem ab_shifted_moments_eq_of_nineRawFeatures_eq (p q : Parameters)
    (hp : Admissible p) (hq : Admissible q)
    (hF : nineRawFeatures p = nineRawFeatures q) :
    pulseShiftedMoment p.t0 p.rR p.rAB jcPairExponent p.t1 =
        pulseShiftedMoment q.t0 q.rR q.rAB jcPairExponent q.t1 ∧
      pulseShiftedMoment p.t0 p.rR p.rAB (2 * jcPairExponent) p.t1 =
        pulseShiftedMoment q.t0 q.rR q.rAB (2 * jcPairExponent) q.t1

theorem ab_bounded_crossing_separates (D : ℝ → ℝ) (T R c s x : ℝ)
    (hD : Continuous D) (hR : 0 < R) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hs0 : 0 < s) (hsT : s < T) (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hxT : x ≤ T) (hxs : x < s)
    (hxneg : D x < 0)
    (hleft : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, t < s → D t ≤ 0)
    (hright : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, s < t → 0 ≤ D t)
    (hend : 0 ≤ D T)
    (hzero : (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..T, Real.exp (-c * t) * D t) +
        Real.exp (-c * T) * D T / (R + c) = 0) :
    (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..T, Real.exp (-(2 * c) * t) * D t) +
        Real.exp (-(2 * c) * T) * D T / (R + 2 * c) < 0
